runs.outcome: harness: runner NoClassDefFoundError androidx.tracing.Trace; probes did not run
harness gaps (androidx.collection keep, maps parsing, cache-only test reminder); arm64 probes recorded
188 functional PASS; reboot recovery PASS; macOS accel-check reported HVF usable
189 functional PASS; arm64-v8a emulator on macos-15: HVF error HV_UNSUPPORTED (C/D/A)
authoritative: A/B 221 PASS/1 FAIL/3 phase-gated skips; C/D x86_64 install refused as expected; arm64 TCG jobs pending at report time

evidence: ubuntu-24.04-arm: /dev/kvm absent; Google publishes no linux-aarch64 emulator (only linux x64, darwin x64/aarch64, windows x64)
macos-15 (Apple M1 Virtual): emulator -accel-check exit 0 but every arm64-v8a launch failed: HVF error: HV_UNSUPPORTED / failed to initialize HVF (run 38041739528, C/D/A)

arm64_software_cpu.note: arm64-v8a image with -accel off (QEMU TCG) on macos-15; genuine arm64 userspace but not hardware; would not replace a real device

A.x86_64: exact 5/6 PASS, functional 221 PASS/1 FAIL, restart/denied/reboot phases PASS
A.fail: locale UI walkthrough: drawer Settings unreachable (pre-existing, see findings)

B.x86_64: identical to A; resource-shrunk strings: 1004/1075 present per locale, all value-equal, 71 removed, referenced-and-removed only import_link_help/import_link_empty (unreachable dialog)
B.fail: same single UI walkthrough failure as A

findings.type: pre-existing UI defect, not release/ABI/shrink related
findings.detail: Navigation drawer Column (app/src/main/java/net/plainnotes/app/ui/AppShell.kt:136) has no vertical scroll; on a 320x640 screen Settings/About are below the bottom edge and unreachable from the drawer. Reproduced identically in A and B exact and functional.
findings.minimal_fix_proposal: Modifier.verticalScroll(rememberScrollState()) on that Column; needs user authorization (production UI change)

findings.detail: ImportedPlanDialog opens only after NotesViewModel.prepareImportedLink, which has no production caller; R8 removes it and B/D resource shrinking then removes import_link_help/import_link_empty. Not a shrinking regression.
arm64-only APK is refused by Package Manager on devices without arm64-v8a (verified on x86_64). Same for 32-bit-only ARM devices by construction (not executed).

Release instrumentation needs test-support-keep.pro (androidx.tracing, concurrent futures, kotlin stdlib) because AGP strips app-shipped libraries from the test APK; exact mode is therefore production R8 plus those keeps.
